source_files.role: per-body aggregated neurotransmitter predictions (hypothesis for synaptic sign)

notes: Raw files are NOT redistributed with the game and are NOT committed to Git (research/data/raw is ignored).
Body IDs are 64-bit integers; keep as strings in any JSON derived from these files.
Cell-type names, neurotransmitter predictions and any FlyWire-derived parameters are hypotheses to be confirmed against these files, not assumed.
